com.esignal.jstandard.beans.news

Interface StoryRequest

  • All Superinterfaces:
    TurnAroundAware
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultStoryRequest

    public interface StoryRequest
extends TurnAroundAware
    Purpose of this class is to hold request parameters before giving it to News server for requesting a story.

    The client needs to set a unique turnaround for every request along with a story id query.

    Since:
    01-019-0000
    Author:
    Interactive Data
